headline: Calls For Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka To Resign Intensify
seoTitle: Calls For Gibran Rakabuming Raka To Resign In DPR
metaDescription: Indonesian lawmakers from the PKS party have called for Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka to resign amid rising parliamentary pressure for removal.
aiSummaryBullets: Members of the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) publicly urged Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka to resign from his position.
Lawmaker Yanuar Arif Wibowo displayed a poster reading 'Mas Gibran Mundur atau Dimundurkan' following a plenary session at the DPR.
PKS Secretary General Muhammad Kholid stated that if the Vice President does not step down voluntarily, constitutional impeachment processes may proceed.
aiContextParagraph: The political environment in Indonesia has shifted following a recent plenary session of the House of Representatives (DPR), where discussions regarding the status of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka gained significant attention. Members of the Prosperous Justice Party (PKS) utilized the parliamentary platform to voice their demands for his resignation. During the post-recess plenary session on November 10, 2026, PKS representative Yanuar Arif Wibowo displayed a poster calling for the Vice President to either resign or face removal. Party leadership, including Secretary General Muhammad Kholid, emphasized that a voluntary departure would be preferable to the initiation of formal impeachment proceedings. As constitutional discussions regarding the use of the DPR's right to express an opinion continue to circulate, political analysts note the heightened tension within the legislative body concerning the Vice President's future in office.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to rapid reporting across three major media outlets following a high-profile demonstration within the DPR plenary session.
